description.en: MONO- AND DIGLYCERIDES OF FATTY ACIDS -E471- refers to a food additive composed of diglycerides and monoglycerides which is used as an emulsifier.
GELATIN or GELATINE is a translucent, colorless, brittle -when dry-, flavorless food ingredient that is derived from collagen obtained from various animal body parts.
RENNET is a complex set of enzymes produced in the stomachs of ruminant mammals. Chymosin, its key component, is a protease enzyme that curdles the casein in milk.
